agentPanel.gitBashMissingText: Kimi Code runs its commands in Git Bash. Install Git for Windows, then check again. If Git is in another folder, set KIMI_SHELL_PATH to its bash.exe and restart the IDE.

hints.default: Edits in the project go through, commands and connectors ask
hints.auto: Everything goes through, dangerous commands still ask
hints.plan: Kimi explores and plans, changes nothing
hints.bypassPermissions: Nothing asks. Only where mistakes are cheap

blocked.trustText: Kimi Code will read, edit and run commands in this folder, with this project's AGENTS.md. Trust only folders you know.

loginGate.text: Sign in with your Kimi account. Kimi opens the sign-in page in your browser and shows a code to enter there. The panel picks it up on its own.
loginGate.finish: Confirm the sign-in on the page - this screen closes by itself.
loginGate.noTerminal: The sign-in didn't go through. Try again.

message.rewindSub: Files {{agent}} changed after this message go back. The conversation stays as it is
